legend.implemented: Code exists, is exercised by tests or a build, and is deployable for its documented scope.
legend.partial: Some production path is missing; the limitation is documented.
legend.ui-only: A view exists but has no backend behaviour.
legend.not-established: No independent evidence; must not be presented as delivered.

components.name: Passkeys and WebAuthn
components.evidence: passkey.ts, Credential Manager client; registration/authentication, origin/RP checks, counter replay defence; dashboard tests

components.name: QR login (phone approves browser)
components.evidence: qrlogin.ts and server tests complete; MainActivity reads the approval intent and routes it to LoginApprovalScreen via ConsoleRoot, but the end-to-end device flow is not exercised in CI

components.name: CLI device grant and PKCE
components.evidence: oauth.ts, cli/; RFC 8628, PKCE S256, refresh rotation; CLI tests and live end-to-end login

components.name: OIDC provider
components.evidence: oidc.ts, api.ts; discovery, JWKS, code+PKCE, ID tokens, userinfo, introspection, revocation, logout; 40 SSO tests

components.name: SAML 2.0 IdP
components.evidence: saml.ts; metadata, signed request verification, signed assertion; 12 tests. No SLO or encrypted assertions

components.name: SCIM 2.0 provisioning
components.evidence: scim.ts; Users/Groups, filters, deprovisioning; 17 tests

components.name: FurlPay relying-party adapter
components.evidence: integrations/furlpay; discovery/JWKS/PKCE/nonce, explicit linking, financial boundary; 9 integration tests

components.name: FurlPay live backend integration
components.evidence: No FurlPay backend or credentials in this repository; contract and deployable adapter only

components.name: Web passkey sign-in and management
components.evidence: login page conditional UI and passkey button, /security page, register/list/delete APIs; browser ceremony itself is not unit-testable

components.name: WebAuthn payment step-up
components.evidence: stepup.ts issues action/payload-bound 5-minute tokens after UV assertion; FurlPay adapter verifies signature/aud/action/payload; 4 tests

components.name: Android OIDC PKCE migration
components.evidence: Passkey approval intent is routed through MainActivity/ConsoleRoot; app session and CLI login still use the cookie/ticket paths, and no push transport exists

components.name: CloudShell OIDC migration
components.evidence: CloudShell still uses the short-lived, single-use terminal ticket issued behind the operator bearer credential; no OIDC-issued ticket path

components.name: Functions runtime
components.evidence: Two runtimes: a bounded node:vm runtime (frozen globals, 32 KB source, 256 KB output, 250 ms budget, codeGeneration disabled) that is fail-closed in production, and an opt-in process-isolated runner (isolate.ts, MOBILECLOUD_ISOLATED_RUNTIME=1) that executes each handler in a child process with a hard V8 old-space ceiling and a parent kill backstop; 9 hostile-code tests assert the server survives runaway loops, memory hunger and host-global access. It is process/resource isolation, not a filesystem or network jail

components.name: Workflows
components.evidence: In-process sequential steps over owner functions; inherits the functions-runtime gate and uses the same executor

components.name: Competitor Radar self-audit
components.evidence: Curated competitor records (data/radar/items.json) mapped to this file's components, with an allowlisted public-feed list (data/radar/feeds.json) and a guard (scripts/radar.mjs) that enforces a source link, public host, valid mapping and freshness; wired into CI (docs-integrity). The console button and scheduled live fetching are not built

components.name: Builder and project deployment dispatch
components.evidence: Opt-in engine dispatch in builder.ts/api.ts: deploy, rollback and deployment lookup proxy to the core engine only when MOBILECLOUD_BUILDER_URL and MOBILECLOUD_BUILDER_TOKEN are both set; the engine re-validates project, clone URL and ref. Disabled by default (403, recorded as blocked); no per-tenant isolation on the engine side

components.name: Preview isolation
components.evidence: One-time token to cookie; CSP `sandbox` blocks console credentials; loopback-only upstream with privileged ports refused. Separate preview origin not implemented

components.name: Edge tunnel
components.evidence: Ed25519 handshake, yamux, WSS; the signed handshake now binds a relay nonce and enforces a replay cache; not exercised against real hardware

components.name: Edge shield
components.evidence: Blocklist, rate limiter, regex WAF; forwarded headers are honoured only from a configured trusted-proxy allowlist

components.name: Proof-of-reserve kernel and contract
components.evidence: Kernel, contract and testnet baseline exist; quorum key independence and custody are not independently established

components.name: Trading engine
components.evidence: Paper/demo only; live execution is not enabled or validated

components.name: Fleet mesh
components.evidence: Node registry, signed heartbeats and placement; no peer transport, discovery or dashboard wiring

components.name: Billing and payments
components.evidence: Usage is metered and per-period spend caps are enforced (MOBILECLOUD_QUOTA_<METER>; function invocations and workflow runs are rejected with 429 once a cap is reached), but there is no payment provider, wallet, KYC, card vault or invoicing. MOBILECLOUD_PAYMENTS_ENABLED config validation fails closed when incomplete, but no provider is wired

components.name: Team roles and RBAC
components.evidence: rbac.ts owner/member/viewer matrix enforced on every API mutation and in the team console (invite with role, promote/demote with last-owner protection, remove); unknown roles fail closed. Account resources are scoped by owner_id (single account, no org membership tables)

components.name: Social login, magic links, SMS OTP
components.evidence: No provider configuration or delivery transport. MOBILECLOUD_SOCIAL_LOGIN_ENABLED config validation fails closed when incomplete, but no flow is wired

components.name: Push notifications (FCM/APNs)
components.evidence: Android notifier is transport-agnostic; no credentials or delivery test. MOBILECLOUD_PUSH_ENABLED config validation fails closed when incomplete

components.name: KMS/HSM signing
components.evidence: Database signing keys; MOBILECLOUD_KEY_PROVIDER=kms fails configuration validation and now also requires MOBILECLOUD_KMS_KEY_ID, but no KMS-backed signer exists

components.name: Production readiness
components.evidence: Health, config validation, SBOM and runbooks exist; KMS, live FurlPay round trip, Android migration and drills remain
